full_prompt_en: A square geometric illustration fills nearly the entire frame with a monumental stylized face assembled from hard-edged planes and smooth tonal gradients. Behind the face, only narrow wedges of violet, black, cobalt, and red remain visible at the left and lower right edges. A broad silver-gray forehead and angular nose bridge descend through the center, dividing warm amber light on the left from cool deep blue shadow on the right. Under heavy horizontal brows, the eyes are reduced to curved blue and gold slivers with dark pupils, giving the otherwise abstract form a steady, direct gaze. The left cheek becomes a large brilliant yellow-orange triangle that fades toward a pale cream edge. On the right, cobalt and navy planes sink into black, with one hot orange crescent near the eye. The central nose is an elongated white facet whose sharp vertical sides project forward. Below it, a slim dark mouth lies over a narrow vermilion and orange stripe. The chin is a smooth white-gray shape that rounds down into heavy blue-black shadow. At the lower left, a long metallic-looking vertical plane catches a soft silver highlight; at the lower right, a red triangular mass balances it. Every part of the head is simplified into a few large planes, yet fine speckled grain appears inside the smooth gradients, particularly in gray and blue areas. Light seems concentrated from the upper left and front, striking the amber cheek and nose while a profound shadow swallows the opposite side. The image has no surrounding setting and no readable text. The overall composition is frontal, close, and severe, using cool-warm opposition and precise geometric edges to turn a face into a graphic architecture of light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形几何插画让一张巨大的造型化面庞几乎填满画幅，由硬边平面和平滑明暗渐层拼成。脸后只在左边和右下边缘露出狭窄的紫、黑、钴蓝与红色楔形。宽阔银灰额头与折角鼻梁从中央垂下，把左侧暖琥珀色光与右侧冷深蓝影分开。厚重水平眉下，眼睛被缩减成蓝色与金色弯片及暗色瞳孔，使原本抽象的形体有了稳定直视的目光。左脸颊成为大片灿亮黄橘三角形，向浅奶油色边渐淡。右侧，钴蓝与海蓝平面陷入黑色，眼旁有一道炽热橘色弯月。中央鼻部是一道拉长的白色切面，锐利竖边向前突出。其下，细深色嘴巴压在狭窄朱红和橘色条纹上。下巴是平滑的白灰色形状，向下圆转进入沉重蓝黑影。左下方，一道像金属的长竖面承接柔和银色亮部；右下方红色三角形大块与之平衡。头部每处都被简化为少量大型平面，但平滑渐层内部仍有细微颗粒，尤其在灰和蓝色区。光仿佛集中从左上及前方进入，打在琥珀色脸颊与鼻梁上，深邃阴影吞没另一侧。图像没有周围场景或可读文字。整体构图正面、贴近而严厉，以冷暖对抗和准确几何边缘把面庞转为由光组成的图形建筑。
style_prompt_en: This geometric graphic style builds forms from a few oversized angular facets with crisp joints and finely graded interiors. Brilliant amber and vermilion press against cobalt, navy, violet, silver-gray, and near-black, so color temperature divides the frame into opposing light and shadow zones. Hard triangular and vertical boundaries supply structure, while subtle stippled grain prevents the gradients from feeling sterile. Highlights appear as broad luminous planes rather than tiny gloss points; shadows are deep, clean masses with smooth tonal falloff at selected inner edges. The composition is tightly cropped and nearly frontal, relying on asymmetrical warm-cool balance more than perspective. Its overall effect is monumental, controlled, and dramatically graphic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种几何图形风格由少量超大的折角切面建立形体，接缝清脆、内部有细致渐层。灿亮琥珀与朱红压向钴蓝、海蓝、紫、银灰和近黑，使色温把画面分成相对的光与影区域。硬朗三角形和竖向边界提供结构，细微点状颗粒避免渐层显得无菌。高光成为宽阔发亮平面，而非小光泽点；阴影是深而干净的大块，只在部分内缘平滑退淡。构图裁切紧密且近乎正面，主要依靠不对称冷暖平衡，而非透视。整体效果巨大、克制，具有戏剧性的图形力量。
theme_en: A monumental geometric face in blue, white and amber
theme_zh: 蓝白琥珀色构成的巨幅几何面庞
name: Mark Kostabi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
